versions.changelog:
Initial release: Provides full guide for configuring ClawHub domestic mirror to bypass rate limits and install Multi Search Engine skill efficiently.

- Covers CLI and environment variable methods for using cn.clawhub-mirror.com mirror.
- Includes installation steps for Multi Search Engine with strategies for 17 search engines.
- Details permanent knowledge archiving process to `.learnings/` and work directory sync.
- Summarizes common pitfalls and troubleshooting solutions for mirror configuration.
- Offers quick reference commands and advanced search operator examples.
